proposal.root_cause: Commit bf1cc543e4e6c80b906d04132cbb187488031e24 added `securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true` to the worker container in deploy/demo/worker.yaml, which is incompatible with the root-user python:3.12-alpine image, causing CreateContainerConfigError.
proposal.rationale: Pod worker-56f9c8ddd-k4zj7 is Pending with CreateContainerConfigError: 'container has runAsNonRoot and image will run as root'. Git history shows commit bf1cc543e4e6c80b906d04132cbb187488031e24 ('chore(demo): update worker.yaml') added the container securityContext `runAsNonRoot: true` to deploy/demo/worker.yaml, while the image python:3.12-alpine runs as root (no USER directive), so kubelet rejects container creation. Removing the two added lines restores the last known good spec from before that commit.
proposal.verify: After Argo CD syncs the reverted deploy/demo/worker.yaml, the worker ReplicaSet rolls a new pod whose worker container starts (no CreateContainerConfigError events), and the pod reaches Ready with Deployment worker showing 1/1 available.
